successPatterns.name: Free-first no-guess journey
successPatterns.value: Combines a meaningful free starting service with explicit uncertainty, readiness lanes, and professional escalation.
successPatterns.reuse: Evaluate for every portal; adapt questions, risk lanes, and professional categories.

successPatterns.name: Full/lean overlay governance
successPatterns.value: Protects large official asset sets while allowing small continuation builds.
successPatterns.reuse: Use only where a portal has heavy immutable assets or required base packages.

successPatterns.name: Side-specific Contract Board
successPatterns.value: Surfaces competing interpretations, disagreement, negotiation choices, and final consolidation.
successPatterns.reuse: Adapt for adversarial documents and multi-party decisions; do not copy into simple forms.

successPatterns.name: Launch-to-compliance roadmap
successPatterns.value: Keeps users engaged after formation through tax, licensing, filing, and lifecycle reminders.
successPatterns.reuse: Adapt to portals with recurring duties and post-completion obligations.

successPatterns.name: Estate completion checkpoints
successPatterns.value: Separates drafting, signing, notarization, filing, funding, transfer, and final delivery.
successPatterns.reuse: Use wherever formal execution or post-signing actions matter.

successPatterns.name: Free Coverage Truth Check
successPatterns.value: Starts with the user’s real plan, household, providers, prescriptions, bills, notices, and life event.
successPatterns.reuse: Adapt the truth-check concept for notices, contracts, returns, benefits, and existing documents.

successPatterns.name: Artifact-to-registry-to-continuation learning loop
successPatterns.value: Turns every verified portal audit into reusable evidence, adoption decisions, specialty adaptations, and portable continuation context.
successPatterns.reuse: Mandatory evaluation for every portal; never treat a source-portal feature as implemented in a target portal without artifact evidence.

successPatterns.name: Central professional identity and firm seats
successPatterns.value: Avoids separate conflicting professional accounts across focused portals.
successPatterns.reuse: All legal, tax, accounting, broker, and approved professional portals should use the central identity model.
